key-number.purpose: The one most important number per screen.

page-title.purpose: Today, Recipes, Foods, Settings, a recipe's name.

label.purpose: Small grey label above a number or a section.

motion.name: base
motion.purpose: Collapses, fades, a closing sheet's scrim.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Matcha action button, full width in forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #4F6B2E); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 16px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, scale 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, #4F6B2E) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #4F6B2E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary choice beside a primary one (Skip, Try the demo).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #171717); height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(0,0,0,.115)); border-radius: 10px; font: 500 16px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #F0F0F0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #4F6B2E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input with unit
components.description: A number box with its unit inside the right edge.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 500 16px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-box { position: relative; } .ds-box input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 48px 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border, #858585); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #171717); font: 400 16px Figtree, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-box input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #4F6B2E); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-box em { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 50%; translate: 0 -50%; font: 400 14px Figtree, sans-serif; font-style: normal; color: var(--muted-foreground, #616161); }

components.name: Tab bar
components.description: Bottom tabs; butter pill marks where you are, round matcha Scan in the middle.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); align-items: center; justify-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(0,0,0,.115)); background: var(--background, #fff); font: 500 16px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs a { height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #616161); } .ds-tabs a[aria-current] { background: var(--highlight, #F2C94C); color: var(--highlight-foreground, #171717); } .ds-scan { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #4F6B2E); }

components.name: Reason chip
components.description: Why a swap card ranks where it does.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--inset, #E8E8E8); color: var(--primary, #4F6B2E); font: 500 13px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Tile
components.description: The grey section every part of a screen sits on.
components.css: .ds-tile { padding: 16px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--card, #F0F0F0); color: var(--card-foreground, #171717); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-label { margin: 0; font: 500 13px Figtree, sans-serif; color: var(--muted-foreground, #616161); } .ds-key { margin: 4px 0 0; font: 700 48px/1 Figtree, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--primary, #4F6B2E); }

narrative.overview: Black ink on white paper with one matcha-green accent, like a tidy recipe card pinned inside a kitchen cupboard, not a finance dashboard. Every screen is a stack of soft grey tiles on a white page, each holding one thing. Colour is rationed, dark mode is a real second design, and motion is quiet everywhere except the swap card stack.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (matcha, hue 130 read from --accent-h), one highlight (butter), one warning (tomato).
Flat tiles on paper; depth by tone, never shadow.
Concentric corners: nested radii are the outer radius minus the gap.
Missing stays missing: "—" and "+ 1 food without protein", never a quiet 0.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Matcha is the only accent. If something needs attention and isn't an action or the key number, it gets weight or size, not a colour.

rules.name: The Butter Means Here Rule
rules.body: Butter marks where you are (active tab, chosen option) and nothing else. Warnings are tomato.

rules.name: The Measured Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every text colour passes 4.5:1 on every surface it can land on, checked by lib/color.test.ts. Unavailable buttons are greyed with colour, never faded with opacity.

rules.name: The One Big Number Rule
rules.body: Bold is for page titles and the single key number. Everything else is regular or medium.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular-nums, including the big one and every price in a list.

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A layer shows it's above another by being one lightness step away, never by a drop shadow.

dos: Do use the colour tokens as classes (bg-card, text-muted-foreground, border-field-border); hex only in lib/app-identity.ts.
Do keep exactly one 48 px bold number per screen, with a 13 px grey label above it.
Do put every section on a tile, and boxes you type in straight on the tile or sheet, white.
Do write a nested radius from its outer token (the Concentric Rule).
Do take motion values from lib/motion.ts (150 / 200 / 250 ms, EASE_OUT, SPRING) and give every animation a Reduce Motion version.
Do design the empty, loading, error and first-use state of every screen.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass or purple; depth is tone.
Don't use emoji as icons; icons are Lucide, with strokes matched to the text (0.094em).
Don't use matcha-soft for text or as the only sign of something.
Don't put an input or a red button on a tile inside a dark sheet (2.9:1 and 3.99:1); put them straight on the sheet.
Don't show 0 or a lower total that quietly leaves an unknown out.
Don't tilt, lift or rotate the swap cards.
